senses.gloss: (prob. corruption of <cite ref="A03093"><he>אֲרִיחַ</he></cite>) pr. n. pl.
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:17:1">Cant. R. to II, 17</cite> (ref. to <he>הרי בתר</he> ibid. ‘mountains of cutting’) <he>כדי שיטלו המלכיות בֶּתֶר א׳</he> (not <he>שיתלו</he>, v. Matt. Keh. a. l.) that the (Roman) governments may receive (their pay for) the massacre of Ar. (cmp. Joseph. B. J. III, 10, 9 sq. or perh. ref. to the Bar Kokhba war; cmp. <he>גופנית</he>, <he>טור שמעון</he> a. oth.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:5:13">Y. Taan. IV, 69ᵃ</cite> sq.).
